critical_code_review_comments: server.py:426 CORS origin parsing via os.environ.get('CORS_ORIGINS', '*').split(',') is correct; with CORS_ORIGINS='*' it results in allow_origins=['*']. Combined with allow_credentials=True this is technically non-standard (Starlette will emit a warning and browsers ignore credentials when '*') but does not affect this app because no cookies are used. Non-blocking.
server.py:378-385 ADMIN_KEY guard treats empty env as universal 401 (correct defensive behavior).
frontend/.env exposes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly; consumed via process.env in api.ts (validated indirectly — no API errors seen in console during smoke).
